cases.title: A repeat count too large for re.compile (a{4294967296}, a{99999999999999999999}, a{1,99999999999999999999}, a{99999999999999999999,}) never raises out of judge
cases.given: judge, regex_error and ref_format_error loaded by path in python3 -I, from commit 6ad4424
cases.when: the function is called with the inputs named in the title
cases.then: judge returns a dict with result unevaluated and a note starting 'cannot evaluate big: '
cases.expected: judge returns a dict with result unevaluated and a note starting 'cannot evaluate big: '
cases.actual: judge raised OverflowError 'the repetition number is too large' for all four patterns, with negate true and false. re.compile rejects each with OverflowError, not re.error. The fix catches re.error and RecursionError only.
cases.specSource: R-035 quote: a pattern re.compile rejects gives None; it never blocks

seeds.title: regex_error and _raw_result catch exception types one by one
seeds.detail: The r0 fix added RecursionError. re.compile also raises OverflowError for a repeat count above the C limit. One handler for the exceptions re.compile raises on bad input would close the class. MemoryError is not reproduced.
